columns.name: RESULT_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for this result.

columns.name: IS_SUCCESS
columns.description: Indicates whether or not the attempt on the Activity was successful.

columns.name: IS_COMPLETION
columns.description: Indicates whether or not the Activity was completed.

columns.name: RESPONSE
columns.description: A response appropriately formatted for the given Activity.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Period of time over which the Statement occurred. The expected format should be ISO 8601.

columns.name: SCORE_SCALED
columns.description: The score related to the experience as modified by scaling and/or normalization.

columns.name: SCORE_MIN
columns.description: The lowest possible score for the experience described by the Statement.

columns.name: SCORE_MAX
columns.description: The highest possible score for the experience described by the Statement.

columns.name: SCORE_RAW
columns.description: The score achieved by the Actor in the experience described by the Statement.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
